title: Topic 7: Daily Routine & Habits - Writing
canDoStatement: Say what you do every day

writingTask.writingPrompt:
STEP 1 - MODEL (student reads):
  Every day I get up in the morning.
  I drink water and I go to work.
  At night I study English.
  My sister watches TV - she sleeps in the morning!

STEP 2 - GAP-FILL the model (tap: watches / get up / at) -
3 gaps (scaffold fading):
  Every day I ___ in the morning.     -> get up
  ___ night I study English.          -> At
  My sister ___ TV.                   -> watches
  (warm-up, auto-checked, not scored)

STEP 3 - WRITE YOUR OWN VERSION (typed, teacher-graded):
Prompt: Write about YOUR day, morning to night.
Minimum requirements:
  - 4 to 5 sentences
  - 3+ routine verbs (get up, eat, drink, go, work, study,
    watch, sleep)
  - every day / in the morning / at night: use 2 of these
  - one 3rd person sentence with -s (My mother works...)
